verdict.rationale: jo's homepage says you can 'give jo a job and a schedule' and get recurring outputs such as a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time. Its always-on cloud machine lets it run overnight and prepare your morning, and its briefings pull in GitHub and Linear context, so recurring scheduled jobs are a core documented capability. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how schedules are defined, edited, listed, or paused; support for multi-step workflows beyond briefing-style jobs; failure and retry visibility; and independent or hands-on corroboration.
